title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1987-05-02
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > dBpoweramp (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2023 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy
source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: Excellent ultramatrix recording captures a stellar performance highlighted by mesmerizing drums and space.
ai_review.review: The set is praised as great from start to finish, with the reviewer calling it a must‑hear. The standout moment noted is the drum/space segment that “took me there,” underscoring both the musical flow and the high‑quality matrix mix.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the music and recording, indicating an outstanding show with excellent sound; limited data keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the recording as great and a must‑hear, implying clear, balanced ultramatrix mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently strong throughout; the drum/space portion is highlighted as an especially immersive moment.

band_member_comments.Drums: The drums/space segment was singled out as a transportive, standout part of the show.
